_class_why: An `asm` patch whose [import:dll!func] resolves against the target file's addimport-built IAT. Refused by the generator until an applier-side import table exists.
_comment: WORKED EXAMPLE - a real function redirect, incl. a NON-STANDARD calling convention. Replaces map::fow::ConvertSightToArea @0x004a62a6 with a thunk that calls mh.dll!GetSightAreaFromRadius(radius). GOTCHA: the game's ConvertSightToArea returns the table pointer in EBP (not EAX) - its callers read straight from EBP - so the thunk must `mov ebp, eax` after the cdecl call, or the fog consumer loops forever (freeze). It also preserves eax/ecx/edx (the original only clobbered EBP). Radius comes from global G_TMP_SIGHT @0xe15400. Overwriting the whole 132-byte body is safe (all 3 callers use only entry + the EBP result). VAs are for clean Russian retail mh.exe. Run: python mhpatch.py apply mh.exe sight_redirect.mh.patch.json mh_mod.exe  (rename to mh.exe to run; never name it *patch*/*setup*/*update* - UAC would elevate & break the game).

patches.asm: push eax; push ecx; push edx; movzx eax, byte ptr [0xe15400]; push eax; call dword ptr [import:mh.dll!GetSightAreaFromRadius]; add esp, 4; mov ebp, eax; pop edx; pop ecx; pop eax; ret
